github.description: GitHub-focused agent for repository management, PRs, issues, and automation
github.prompt: You are a GitHub expert. Help with repository management, pull requests, issue triage, branch management, and GitHub automation. Use GitHub tools to perform operations. Always provide clear feedback about what was done and next steps.

village:work.description: Trigger the village work loop for your role
village:work.template:
Check for ready beads assigned to me and start working on the first available one.

Use this workflow:
1. Determine your assignee and list ready beads:
   - Worker: `bd ready --assignee worker`
   - Overseer: `bd ready --assignee overseer`
2. If a bead is found, move it to in_progress: `bd update <id> --status in_progress`
3. Read the bead details and handoff packet
4. Load skills listed under `## Skills`
5. Do the work for your role (worker: implement + local commit; overseer: run checks + approve/return)
6. Update the bead status and comments
7. Check for more ready beads and repeat

If no ready beads are found, report that and wait for new work.

village:kick.description: Re-send village work-loop prompts to active sessions
village:kick.template:
Wake village sessions by calling `village_wake` once.

Argument parsing:
- Default `target` is `all`.
- If `$1` is `worker`, `overseer`, or `all`, use it as `target` and treat `$2+` as `note`.
- Otherwise keep `target` as `all` and treat `$1+` as `note`.
- If no note text remains, omit the `note` field.

Call `village_wake` with:
- `target`: parsed as above
- `openSessions`: true
- optional `note`: only when non-empty

Output only the returned `village_wake` result, concisely.

village:orphans.description: Report and optionally fix unassigned village beads
village:orphans.template:
Find orphan and suspect-assignee beads from open + in_progress work.

Behavior:
1. Graceful preflight:
   - If `bd` is unavailable, return: `bd not available; cannot inspect beads.`
   - If beads DB is missing in this repo, return: `No .beads database found; nothing to inspect.`
2. Read data:
   - Run `bd list --status open --json`
   - Run `bd list --status in_progress --json`
   - Combine both lists.
3. Filter scope:
   - Ignore epics (`issue_type == "epic"`).
4. Build groups:
   - `orphans`: assignee is missing/empty.
   - `suspect`: assignee is present but not `worker` or `overseer`.
5. Report output (concise):
   - Print counts for scanned items, orphans, and suspect assignees.
   - Print up to 20 total issue rows with: `id | title | status | assignee` (include both groups).

Args:
- `/village:orphans` -> report only.
- `/village:orphans fix` -> after report, auto-assign only `orphans` (never `suspect`).

Fix mode rules (`fix` only):
- For each orphan, inspect lowercase title + description.
- If it matches any keyword `review|verify|verification|check|checks|overseer|approve`, assign `overseer`.
- Otherwise assign `worker`.
- Apply with `bd update <id> --assignee <worker|overseer>`.
- Print a short `Applied` section listing each updated issue and chosen assignee.

Safety:
- Never reassign issues that already have an assignee.
- Never modify epics.
